summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled <fieldset> ancestor also disables it without changing the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The sliding circle; moves to the end of the track while on.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the primary color and the thumb moves to the end (mirrored in rtl).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated mixin: setFormValue(value) only while on, null when off; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError); formResetCallback restores the checked attribute default; formStateRestore restores saved state; disabled (own or fieldset) is not submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (sm 24x16px); the label beside it is part of the clickable row, and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; aria-checked follows its checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
on/off is shown by thumb position and track fill, not by color alone
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once
The on/off value must be submitted or validated with a form
useCases.use: sb-switch with name, and required where it must be on

useCases.when: The consequence of the setting needs explaining
A compact row in a dense settings list

antiPatterns.pattern: Picking several options from a list, or a choice only recorded on submit
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as an immediate setting; checkboxes record a choice

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: Switches are independent of each other

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that names the state ("On") instead of the setting
antiPatterns.why: The label is the only accessible name and the switch already shows the state
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that names the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn's off track is a lighter input color, below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the APG switch pattern and the visual reference for look and sizes. Taken with the recommendation; no one was available to approve (SB-0011).

openQuestions.question: Is the control a native input or an ARIA role on a div?
openQuestions.answer: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">: native elements first (SB-0007). Keyboard, focus, validity and label activation come from the browser.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, as in Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Is there an indeterminate state?
openQuestions.answer: No. A switch is on or off (APG); the visual reference has none either.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default and sm, as the visual reference (aliases of medium and small in the size vocabulary). No lg.

openQuestions.question: What does an off switch submit?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing. While on it submits value (default "on"), like a native checkbox.

openQuestions.question: How is the error shown?
openQuestions.answer: An error prop, as in Checkbox: customError validity, aria-invalid, destructive track border and a polite live region.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle?
openQuestions.answer: No. Space toggles; Enter submits the form, as in Checkbox (SB-0009).
